findings.motion: Second Reading, HB 958 Election Law Changes (Senate; passed 28-13)
findings.note: Voted no on second reading of HB 958. The ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) includes a rule that a voter registration application is processed only if it states the applicant is a U.S. citizen, with a 30-day notice and a sworn citizenship statement if the answer is blank, and a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. It also changes precinct officials, early voting days, ballot challenges and campaign finance. She also voted yes on Amendment 1 and no on Amendments 2, 3, 5 and 6 to 10 (motions to table) on the same day. She voted no on HB 1035 (Various Local Election Changes III) on 2026-06-16. The vote page was read through a page summary; confirm on the page.
